gaps: Dry Corridor household coping and Caribbean Coast repression/armed displacement concern different places and must not be spliced into an inferred climate–violence pathway.

executive_assessment.text: The Dry Corridor evidence links erratic rain and production stress with food and schooling coping, without municipal incidence estimates.
Bilwi/Waspam information channels and Alal conflict displacement add local FCV context; neither establishes that climate caused armed violence or that radio closure measurably reduced adaptation.
SINAREM launch and WFP plan priorities are institutional/design evidence, not verified performance.
